name: CNC Mill #1
notes: Machine underwent full spindle rebuild in January 2025. Coolant system uses Castrol Hysol 3000 at 8% concentration. Do not run above 10,000 RPM until 50-hour break-in is complete.

parts.notes: Replace every 2,000 hours. Check tension monthly.
Match-ground pair — always replace both upper and lower together.
Check for contact welding if machine fails to e-stop cleanly.
Grease with Mobilith SHC 220 every 500 hours.

documents.title: Spindle Rebuild Procedure
documents.description: Step-by-step spindle disassembly, inspection, bearing replacement, and reassembly

steps: Verify the enclosure door is fully closed and the door safety switch (J1 Pin 6) reads 24VDC.
Check that no active alarms are displayed on the control panel. Clear alarms before retrying.
Confirm e-stop is fully released — check J1 Pin 3 reads 24VDC at the controller board connector.
Navigate to the VFD keypad and check for a fault code. Compare fault code against the VFD fault table in the Electrical Schematics (see Related Document).
Check the FAULT_OUT line on J4 Pin 5. If LOW, the VFD has an active fault — cycle VFD power after resolving the root cause.
If no VFD fault exists, verify the FWD command on J4 Pin 3 is present when a spindle start command is issued.
If FWD signal is absent, suspect the main controller board output — contact supervisor before further disassembly.

troubleshooting.symptom: Excessive vibration at the spindle during cutting
steps: Stop the machine immediately. Do not continue cutting.
Check tool holder for damage, contamination, or improper seating in the spindle taper.
Inspect the cutting tool for chips, breakage, or runout greater than 0.001 inches.
Check spindle drive belt (HA-930-8765) tension and condition. A loose or cracked belt will cause vibration at certain RPM ranges.
Run the spindle at low RPM (500–1000) with no tool loaded. If vibration persists, suspect spindle bearing wear.
Check lubrication at all listed spindle lubrication points — refer to lubrication guide.
If spindle bearing wear is suspected, tag machine out of service and notify the maintenance supervisor.

troubleshooting.symptom: Coolant pump runs but no coolant flow at nozzle
steps: Check the coolant tank level. Minimum level is the LOW mark on the side of the reservoir.
Inspect the coolant pump inlet screen for chips or debris — clean with a brush if clogged.
Check all coolant lines for kinks, collapsed hoses, or loose fittings.
Inspect the coolant nozzle for blockage. Use compressed air to clear.
If pump runs but flow is very weak, the pump seal may be failing — check for coolant in the sump area around the pump housing.
If pump seal failure is suspected, replace using the Coolant Pump Seal Kit (HA-32-0154). See Operator's Manual, Chapter 9 for procedure.

troubleshooting.symptom: Tool changer faults mid-cycle or carousel does not index
steps: Clear all alarms from the control panel.
Manually jog the tool changer carousel using the pendant to check for binding or resistance.
Inspect the cam follower (HA-910-2233) for wear, flat spots, or dry lubrication. Apply Mobilith SHC 220 if dry.
Check the tool changer home proximity sensor — verify it triggers cleanly at the home position.
Inspect for any chips or foreign debris inside the carousel housing.
Run a carousel-only test cycle at low speed and observe the motion. Note at which pocket position the fault recurs.
If fault consistently occurs at the same pocket, inspect that pocket's retention mechanism for damage.
